producer_report.summary: Added the `context` line to `athena status`. A new module, `crates/athena-core/src/context_load.rs`, groups closed request jobs by class of work. For each class it prints the mean input + cache-read + cache-write tokens per landed job, the landed share of that class's closed jobs, and the mistakes attached to those same closed jobs. Output tokens are excluded. A class needs at least 3 landed jobs with a token record, and with none qualifying the line is absent. Mistakes with no job, or on a job outside a shown class, are counted in a separate note and never folded into a class. A test checks that shown plus left-out equals `mistake_report` total. The new field is `StatusView.context_load`, printed by `display::status`. OLY-B-A13-01 now has a real mechanism and a measure ending `status: context`. Added `crates/athena-core/tests/context_compression.rs`, an end-to-end display test in `display.rs`, a `shard-timings.txt` line, a CHANGELOG entry and appended decision D175. On the earlier drain failure: `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain` passed all 202 tests on the final tree, including the urgent-items test, and no drain code was touched.

open_issues: I did not run the whole-workspace `cargo test --locked`. I ran the athena-core, athena-cli and xtask policy/ci_shards/spec targets, which cover everything this change touches. Athena's own check runs the full suite.
The 5.00 s timing for context_compression is an estimate, like the rest of shard-timings.txt.
I ran no real records through the measure: the producer copy has no records/. The owner can see real figures with `athena status` after landing.

Landed jobs with no token record are left out of a class's mean. The count is printed as a note and the 3-job floor counts only jobs with a token record. The plan said only 'landed jobs'; this is a small refinement.
mistakes: First draft of the test file wrapped Intervention in Box::new, which did not compile. Fixed straight away.
Several shell commands (head, grep, tail, a here-document) were refused by the Bash policy; I used Read, Grep and Edit instead.
learnings: Records::load_dir reads <dir>/records and works on a plain tempdir of record files written at canonical_path, so core tests can use the real loader.
AnyRecord::Intervention holds an unboxed Intervention; Job, Invocation and Outcome are boxed.
The measure-label test requires `pub <field>:` in status.rs and a `"label ` literal in status.rs, display.rs or hestia.rs.
athena-cli's unit-test module can build an Athena with athena_core::test_support::make_athena and a script that panics, because status runs no agent.
desires: Allow grep, head and tail in Bash (or let cargo output be filtered), so long test output can be summarised.
